name: Dropping files and folders onto the page
plain: Receives files and whole folders the person drags onto the page, with no prompt.
meaning: Dropping is consent for exactly what is dropped, including folder trees. The site can read file contents and, in Chrome, ask for write access to the dropped items.

web.api: drop event; dataTransfer.files; items; webkitGetAsEntry(); getAsFileSystemHandle()

access.revocation: Nothing to revoke (no permission is stored)
access.iframe: Drops go to the document under the pointer; dropped items are same-origin readable only in that document
steps: Person drags files from the OS
Page reads files and walks directory entries

limits.headline: Can receive files or whole folders you drag onto the page
limits.user_action: You drag files from your desktop onto the page and let go.
can: Receive the files and folders you drop
Open the contents of what you dropped
cannot: See the file names before you drop
Take files without a drag and drop
Change the original files, unless you also allow saving in Chrome
Get them again later without another drop

story.what_it_is: Receives files and folders you drag onto the page, with no prompt.

marketing.name: File drag and drop
marketing.pitch: Documents how a page can accept files dragged from a computer onto it.

story.for_you: You drag a file from your desktop onto the page and let go. It is the act of dropping that gives the page the file. No prompt appears because you did it yourself.
story.for_makers: It is the easiest way to add files and feels natural. Makers get fast uploads and fewer clicks. Because the drop is the consent, no extra prompt is needed.

use_cases.example: You drop a picture or document into a chat window to send it.
You drop a photo into a web editor to start work.
You drop files into a cloud folder in your browser.
You drop a save file or custom map onto a browser game to load it.
You drag a file onto an email to attach it.
You drop a video onto an online converter or editor.
You drop a folder of files onto a web deploy tool.

risks: Easy to drop the wrong file

technical_bounds: Contents readable only inside the drop handler (protected mode otherwise)
Dropped folders: webkitGetAsEntry returns the full tree, readEntries returns at most 100 entries per call in Chrome (loop until empty)
getAsFileSystemHandle (Chrome 86) can request write access to the dropped file with a prompt
Cannot start a drag from OS file locations; cannot read drag data before drop
Dropped item paths are hidden; only names and relative paths
